summary: Zoned Properties Inc. filed an 8-K reporting the sale of its Woodward Property via a wholly-owned subsidiary to Woodward RE 1 LLC. The aggregate purchase price was $700,000 plus assumption of $1,327,371 and $374,826 in land contract obligations, totaling $2,402,197. A $100,000 credit applied for closing on or before May 1, 2026. The board likely recommended the sale; no advisor named. The sale closed simultaneously with the agreement. Watch for any post-closing adjustments or litigation regarding representations.
